verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe cloud RADIUS that authenticates users to Wi-Fi, VPNs, switches and other network devices: admins point their networks at JumpCloud's RADIUS servers and grant access through the directory. The pack never mentions a cloud LDAP endpoint, so the LDAP half of the story, which serves older systems, is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of cloud LDAP service for legacy apps and systems, independent or hands-on corroboration of RADIUS working with real VPN and Wi-Fi gear.
